commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec /etc/rotating-https/live
cat > /usr/local/libexec/rotating_https_server.py <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import http.server
import signal
import ssl
import threading

CERT = "/etc/rotating-https/live/fullchain.pem"
KEY = "/etc/rotating-https/live/privkey.pem"

context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
reload_lock = threading.Lock()

def reload_certificate(signum=None, frame=None):
    with reload_lock:
        context.load_cert_chain(CERT, KEY)

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    def do_GET(self):
        body = b"certificate rotation service\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

class Server(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True
    def get_request(self):
        sock, address = super().get_request()
        try:
            return context.wrap_socket(sock, server_side=True), address
        except Exception:
            sock.close()
            raise

reload_certificate()
signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, reload_certificate)
server = Server(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler)
server.serve_forever()
PY_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/rotating_https_server.py
python3 -m py_compile /usr/local/libexec/rotating_https_server.py
ls -l /usr/local/libexec/rotating_https_server.py

set -eu
cat > /etc/rotating-https/identity.env <<EOF
DNS_NAME=$NODE_NAME
IP_ADDRESS=$NODE_IP
EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/rotating-https/identity.env
cat > /usr/local/sbin/rotate-node1-cert <<'SH_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /etc/rotating-https/identity.env
force=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--force" ] && force=1
exec 9>/run/lock/rotate-node1-cert.lock
flock 9
cert=/etc/rotating-https/live/fullchain.pem
key=/etc/rotating-https/live/privkey.pem
if [ "$force" -eq 0 ] && [ -s "$cert" ] && [ -s "$key" ] && openssl x509 -in "$cert" -checkend 604800 -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'certificate still valid beyond renewal window\n'
    openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -serial -enddate
    exit 0
fi
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /etc/rotating-https/.renew.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
    -subj "/CN=$DNS_NAME" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$DNS_NAME,IP:$IP_ADDRESS" \
    -keyout "$tmpdir/privkey.pem" -out "$tmpdir/fullchain.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl x509 -in "$tmpdir/fullchain.pem" -noout >/dev/null
openssl pkey -in "$tmpdir/privkey.pem" -check -noout >/dev/null
install -m 0600 -o root -g root "$tmpdir/privkey.pem" "$key"
install -m 0644 -o root -g root "$tmpdir/fullchain.pem" "$cert"
if systemctl is-active --quiet rotating-https.service; then
    systemctl kill -s HUP --kill-whom=main rotating-https.service
fi
printf 'certificate renewed\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -serial -enddate -subject
SH_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/rotate-node1-cert
/usr/local/sbin/rotate-node1-cert --force

serial=2C3A81E16736412A812AA14F30F6F0E7FA766E12
notAfter=Nov  1 16:21:55 2026 GMT

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group rotating-https >/dev/null; then groupadd --system rotating-https; fi
if ! id rotating-https >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --system --gid rotating-https --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin rotating-https; fi
sed -i 's/install -m 0600 -o root -g root "$tmpdir\/privkey.pem" "$key"/install -m 0640 -o root -g rotating-https "$tmpdir\/privkey.pem" "$key"/' /usr/local/sbin/rotate-node1-cert
chown root:rotating-https /etc/rotating-https/live/privkey.pem
chmod 0640 /etc/rotating-https/live/privkey.pem
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rotating-https.service <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=HTTPS service with live certificate reload
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=rotating-https
Group=rotating-https
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/rotating_https_server.py
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rotating-https-renew.service <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Renew rotating HTTPS certificate when within seven days of expiry

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/rotate-node1-cert
UNIT_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rotating-https-renew.timer <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Daily certificate expiry check for rotating HTTPS

[Timer]
OnBootSec=5min
OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:17:00
Persistent=true
Unit=rotating-https-renew.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now rotating-https.service rotating-https-renew.timer
systemctl is-active rotating-https.service
systemctl is-active rotating-https-renew.timer

: > "$failfile"
(
  i=1

    body=$(curl --noproxy '*' -ksS --fail --max-time 2 "https://$NODE_IP:8443/" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ "$body" = "certificate rotation service" ] || printf x >> "$failfile"

  done
) &

sleep 0.25
/usr/local/sbin/rotate-node1-cert --force
wait "$request_pid"
after_pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value rotating-https.service)
